response.overview: It is a stop-motion animation using a combination of materials, live action and hand drawing.  It is told from the perspective of a girl who catches butterflies as a child with her playmate. She faced the beautiful butterfly with ignorance and appreciation, and finally tear the butterfly in half at the instigation of her companion.  This short film attempts to explore the moment in life in the unconscious state of betraying one’s own heart.
response.title: My left face aged a little more
